title: Vanilla+++
body:
Vanilla+++

A vanilla-friendly Minecraft modpack that improves performance, visuals, and quality-of-life while keeping the core gameplay experience intact.

This pack is designed for players who want Minecraft to feel like vanilla—but smoother, prettier, and more convenient. It includes performance optimizations, subtle visual upgrades, helpful UI improvements, and small gameplay tweaks without changing the core survival progression.

Features:

Performance improvements using mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and ImmediatelyFast

Beautiful world visuals with Biomes O' Plenty, Continuity, and Falling Leaves

Enhanced graphics support with Iris Shaders and Complementary Shaders – Reimagined

Quality-of-life improvements like AppleSkin, Mouse Tweaks, and Shulker Box Tooltip

Better navigation with Xaero's World Map and Waystones

Built-in proximity chat with Simple Voice Chat
